lines.text: Four legends.
One board.
One trophy.
And tonight... one of them ends up behind bars.
They told you this was just a game. Believe me. It is not.
The prize on this board is the World Cup itself.
Whoever rules the board lifts the cup. Everyone else goes home with nothing.
And the board lives by one ruthless law.
Score a goal, and you seize the ground beneath it.
Set up a teammate, and you advance.
But do neither... and the board throws you in jail.
Round one is over. And it has already crowned a king.
Lionel Messi. Three goals against Algeria. A perfect hat-trick.
He didn't celebrate. He just... collected.
A full set. The richest corner on the board.
Kylian Mbappe ran like the board was burning.
Two goals. And the record that crowns him France's greatest ever. Fifty-eight.
Erling Haaland didn't run. He built.
Two goals. Two houses. A wall rising in the north.
And then there was the king they all came to dethrone.
Cristiano Ronaldo. The greatest of his age.
One match. No goal. No assist.
And the board does not care about your name.
The bars came down on the legend himself.
But they have counted him out before. The world remembers how that ended.
Behind the bars, he is not broken. He is waiting.
So here is the board after round one.
Messi rules. Mbappe and Haaland climb. And the greatest of them all sits in a cell.
But no one wins the cup in a single round.
The dice are rising again.
And a cornered legend, with nothing left to lose,
is the most dangerous player on this board.
One question remains. Who deals this game... and what does he want?
Round two has the answer.
Now... the dice are yours.
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world. Pick your three legends. Collect them all.
Climb the board. Chase the cup. Free to play, for glory alone.
The cell is open. Who escapes first?
